requirement: Robot enters a controlled safe state after loss of approved communications
acceptance_threshold: 100% of 10 induced-loss trials stop within the approved envelope
source_or_validation: Threshold and result require approved hazard analysis and signed SAT evidence

requirement: Operator can correlate a mission to robot, software version, and evidence bundle
acceptance_threshold: 10 of 10 sampled missions have complete identifiers
source_or_validation: Replace with exported operational evidence and approver signature

requirement: Remote access uses approved identity, least privilege, logging, and revocation
acceptance_threshold: All four controls present; no critical exceptions
source_or_validation: Validate against approved security policy and access logs
